We need DBE for C12H15Cl. DBE formula: DBE = C - H/2 + N/2 +1 (ignoring halogens as H). For halogens, treat as H. So effective H = H + X (Cl). So H_eff = 15 + 1 = 16. No N. So DBE = C - H_eff/2 +1 = 12 - 16/2 +1 = 12 -8 +1 =5. So integer 5.

We could retrieve formula via tool but we already know. But to be safe, we can call retrieve_dbe_formula.
